scope: Static-only inspection of user-supplied national civil-service photo tool; no PE execution, DLL loading, Word execution, photo rewriting, account login or service upload

provenance.userProvidedRole: national civil-service exam photo processing tool
provenance.currentExamYearBinding: not-independently-verified; not inferred from ZIP name or supplied instructions

configuration.dimensionValues: EXE defaults via GetPrivateProfileStringA; package INI does not override dimensions
configuration.source30KiBGate: absent from recovered input header function 0x401E90; unlike Henan retained input classifier; no claim about every other code path

evidence: background sampling helper called at 0x401833 and mismatched-background message
Haar detector called at 0x4018E8; no-face branch
head proportion branches and head-proportion message
contentChecks.extraCascadeInArchive: haarcascade_frontalface_alt_tree.xml; presence alone does not establish runtime use

savePath.qualitySetter: 0x408BA0 stores supplied value into CxImage quality field at +0x154
savePath.tailWriter: fopen rb+, seek EOF, fwrite 10 literal bytes, fclose
savePath.cryptoScope: Recovered complete tail writer uses literal constants, no image CRC, hash, random input, user identity, private key or online token; this does not assert all EXE/library code is free of cryptography
savePath.around10K: approximate size described by documentation; no exact 10240-byte output target established
savePath.officialNationalOutputSample: not-provided; actual full JPEG structure, quantization, sampling, DPI and pixels still need sample corroboration

inputRecognition.logic: reads first two bytes and compares FF D8, returns 2 on match or 0 otherwise; no trailer or file-size comparison in this function
inputRecognition.differenceFromHenan: does not implement the Henan already-processed tail comparison; passing input classification is not a processed-output validation or server acceptance test

reusableComponents: controllable JPEG quality-40 encoder, subject to official-output format corroboration
original-file export and returned-file full-byte comparison
changesRequired: national fixed trailer distinct from Henan
national rules and blue/white background guidance
national source limits must not inherit unproven Henan 30 KiB lower bound
record content check coverage separately from output-marker compatibility

nextEvidence: official download URL and exam-year mapping
same-original output from this exact EXE for structural and image comparison
iPhone and Android generated-file delivery checks for national profile
authorized real-applicant upload test when available
